summaries: A Form 10-K annual report for Ascent Industries Co. covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: It contains Consolidated Statements of Income reporting net income of $22.1 million for 2022 and $20.2 million for 2021. While it establishes the financial performance baseline immediately preceding the requested period, it does not include audited financial statements or actual results for 2023 or 2024. Consequently, this filing cannot independently determine the net profit trend from 2023 to 2024, serving instead to confirm the 2022 starting point utilized in the broader collection.

A Form 10-K Annual Report filed by Ascent Industries Co. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: it provides audited net income figures for 2023 ($26.6 million net loss) and 2022 ($22.1 million net income). The document establishes the 2023 baseline required for the trend analysis, showing a significant decline from profitability to a net loss compared to the prior year. However, it does not contain financial results for the fiscal year 2024, as the reporting period ends December 31, 2023. Therefore, it contributes the necessary 2023 data point to the trend analysis but cannot independently determine the movement into 2024 without additional documents covering 2024 performance.
